title: Breaking Boundaries: Investigating the Effects of Model Editing on Cross-linguistic Performance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-lingual knowledge editing performance (reliability, generalization, locality, and portability) across high-resource European languages and low-resource Indic languages using 'each language for itself' (ELFI) and 'each language for others' (ELFO) setups to measure performance disparities.

Analyzing and categorizing translation and editing errors caused by cultural ambiguities, idiomatic expressions, and pragmatic differences that lead to context-specific misunderstandings across languages.
